triggers.name: new_attachment
triggers.title: New button submission
triggers.description: New button submission in Webex Teams
triggers.help: Fetches trigger events as soon as they occur.

triggers.name: new_message
triggers.title: New message
triggers.help: Triggers when a new message is posted in a room. Note: When using Bot access token as the authentication type in connection, The bot should be mentioned in the message for the trigger to work.

input.name: max
input.label: Max
input.hint: Number of existing messages to retrieve starting from the latest (defaults to one)

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in Cisco Webex Teams (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own Cisco Webex Teams action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your Cisco Webex Teams connection OAuth scopes: Scopes messages:read, messages:write, rooms:read, rooms:write, memberships:read, memberships:write, people:read

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

input.name: personEmail
input.label: Person email
input.hint: Email of the person to add to room

output.name: personEmail
output.label: Person email
output.hint: Email of the person to add to room

actions.name: create_room
actions.title: Create room
actions.help: Rooms are used to organize people and messages. Each message is posted to a specific room. Note: Rooms created using Bot access token will be visible only to the bot. Use Add person to room action to add users to the room. Learn more

actions.name: get_attachment_details
actions.title: Get attachment details
actions.description: Get attachment details in Webex Teams

input.name: id
input.label: Attachment action ID
input.hint: Obtained from output of New button submission trigger.

input.name: inputs
input.label: Input schema
input.hint: Must match schema defined in upstream button triggering this recipe.

actions.name: get_message_details
actions.title: Get message details
actions.description: Get message details in Webex Teams

output.name: personId
output.label: Person ID
output.hint: The ID of the recipient when sending a private 1 to 1 message

output.name: personEmail
output.label: Person email
output.hint: The email address of the recipient when sendinga private 1:1 message

output.name: text
output.label: Message
output.hint: This will be replaced by markdown if 'Markdown' is also present.

output.name: markdown
output.label: Markdown
output.hint: Refer here for sample markdown syntax

output.name: toPersonId
output.label: Recipient ID
output.hint: ID of recipient for private messages

output.name: toPersonEmail
output.label: Recipient email
output.hint: Email of recipient for private messages

actions.name: get_person_details
actions.title: Get person details
actions.description: Get person details in Webex Teams

actions.name: get_room_details
actions.title: Get room details
actions.description: Get room details in Webex Teams

actions.name: post_blocks_message
actions.title: Post message
actions.help: Either 'Message' or 'Alternate text' should be present. Note: When using OAuth 2.0 as authentication type in connection, Messages are sent from the Workato oauth user. When using Bot access token as the authentication type in connection, Messages are sent from the bot used in the connection

input.name: roomId
input.label: Room name
input.hint: Room to post the message to for public messages

input.name: markdown
input.label: Alternate text
input.hint: Refer here for sample markdown syntax

input.label: Message
